messages:
kai: Seeing regressed tail latency on host ingress since yesterday deploy. p95 up ~18% on small requests (~<300 tokens). pprof points at tokenizer and gRPC small-write path. Anyone else? cc @alex @maria

alex: yep saw alerts. correlates with 2026-03-18 runtime bump (kernel-picker change).

maria: quick note: kernel selection change added extra fallback checking per-request which touches kvcache; adds ~40us per request.

sam: Can we repro locally? I have a capture from prod -> saved pcap + pprof.

kai: attached short pprof snippet:
```
flat 12%  tokenize
flat 8%   grpc::Writev/flush
flat 5%   TLS::encrypt
```

devops-bot: Deploy 1770011200 rolled to zone-a at 08:12 UTC

alex: I ran microbench: adding fallback check increases median by 5-6us but for small requests it's huge because writev becomes many syscalls. suspect Nagle/SmallWrite + TLS fragmentation.

maria: We also enabled -O2 change in tokenizer that changed buffer alignment; profiling shows extra memcpy in tokenization when crossing 256-byte boundary.

sam: Idea: coalesce micro-writes in ingress sidecar before TLS layer. Add a small ringbuffer + writev aggregator. Also revisit kernel-picker per-request check: cache compatible models per worker.

kai: Patch WIP: wrap grpc->Write with BufferingSink for X ms or until size threshold. Bench results: p95 small req down 12% locally. @alex I'll push PR.

alex: also test disabling fallback-check path: p95 back to baseline but some failover cases lost. Need safer cache of compatible kernels per shard.

maria: KV cache eviction thrash seen: fallback check touches kv before req used, evicting hot entries. Could change to only touch on miss.

sam: I'll run canary with buffering + lazy fallback-touch and measure CPU/time.

bench-bot: Microbench finished: buffering + lazy-touch reduced syscalls by 68%, TLS record count down 60%, p95 reduced by 15%.

kai: Rolling canary to 10% in zone-b. Keeping watch. If stable we'll ship rollback of kernel-picker change and follow-up with buffering.

alex: logging: add counters for writev calls per request and kv-touch per-request. Helps triage next time.

maria: :thumbsup: Also need unit test for tokenizer alignment edge-case.
